steps.code:
# Fetch all note contents and parse them
import re
from datetime import datetime

habits_data = []  # list of dicts: {'date': 'YYYY-MM-DD', 'habits': {habit: value}}
habit_order = []  # to preserve order

for note_meta in all_notes:
    note = apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=access_token, note_id=note_meta['note_id'])
    content = note['content']
    # Extract date from title
    title = note['title']
    m = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', title)
    if not m:
        continue
    date_str = m.group(1)
    # Parse content lines
    lines = content.split('\n')
    habits = {}
    for line in lines:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith('#'):
            continue
        if ':' in line:
            parts = line.split(':', 1)
            habit = parts[0].strip()
            value = parts[1].strip().lower()
            if value not in ('yes', 'no'):
                continue
            habits[habit] = value
            if habit not in habit_order:
                habit_order.append(habit)
    habits_data.append({'date': date_str, 'habits': habits})

# Sort by date
habits_data.sort(key=lambda x: x['date'])
print(f"Parsed {len(habits_data)} notes")
print("Habit order:", habit_order)
print("First few dates:", [d['date'] for d in habits_data[:3]])
